Delhi flags 3.3 million voter records; Kejriwal family votes questioned

Delhi authorities have flagged 3.31 million voter records, according to reports. The process involved mapping names against the 2002 poll rolls, with data indicating that the family of former Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal's votes were not registered in Delhi prior to 2013. This information was reportedly stated by Malhotra.
